labels: Independent human review; never spatial joins or the evaluated model
catalog: Existing eight species plus explicit out-of-catalog negatives
splits: Freeze by individual, campaign and spatial block before inference
duplicates: SHA-256 plus perceptual near-duplicate review; no crossing splits

experiments.B: Existing SAM + Muse on identical cases
experiments.C: BioCLIP2 local only if resources and a labeled dataset justify it
experiments.D: Best measured visual baseline plus audited real context, without hard taxon exclusion
experiments.E: Identical D with fixed-seed context permutation as negative control

paired_comparison: Same independent individuals; report each domain separately
decision: No context improvement claim without a paired measurement and negative-control review
privacy: Hepta images/weights/annotations stay local; no Meta transfer or publication
references: Protected books/slides are not a dataset; a book excerpt is not an independent source
